ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M1-1,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 26-G in the area bound by:

West 105" Street; the east right-of-way line of the Pittsburgh, Cincinnati, Chicago, and
St. Louis Railroad; West 107" Street; and South Throop Avenue,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Rontie L. osley
Alderman, 21% Ward

Common Address:
10501-10659 S. Throop Street
10614-10632 S. Throop Street
1200 W. 106" Street
1237-1243 W. 106" Street
1200-1224 W. 107" Street
